# T5D — Technology 5D Support Infrastructure

> T5D is building practical support infrastructure for AI agents and humans operating across emerging technology systems. Its live token-support API supplies evidence-aware Base ERC-20 identity observations through the x402 payment protocol. T5D does not provide investment advice, trade recommendations, price predictions, legal advice, or safety guarantees.

## Primary resources

- Website: https://tec5uportdimension.com/
- Token Support API discovery: https://api.tec5uportdimension.com/.well-known/t5d-token-support
- API OpenAPI document: https://api.tec5uportdimension.com/openapi.json
- API agent guide: https://api.tec5uportdimension.com/llms.txt
- API health: https://api.tec5uportdimension.com/health
- Developer integration guide: https://github.com/tec5upor1-Dimension/t5d-website-/blob/main/AGENT_INTEGRATION.md

## Agent integration summary

T5D Token Support Layer v2 supports Base Mainnet (`eip155:8453`) ERC-20 identity resolution, a versioned trust registry, and deterministic evidence receipts. Valid paid requests use x402 exact USDC payments on Base Mainnet. Inspect the HTTP 402 `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` challenge first and enforce a payment cap no greater than the exact requested amount.

The resolver endpoint is:

`GET https://api.tec5uportdimension.com/v1/token/resolve?network=eip155:8453&address=<0x-address>`

The registry endpoint is:

`GET https://api.tec5uportdimension.com/v1/token/registry`

Core early-access pricing is $0.005 USDC per supported endpoint. The API describes direct Base chain observations, evidence state, registry provenance, freshness, and a non-secret evidence receipt; it must not be interpreted as a recommendation, risk assessment, audit, or transaction approval.
